authority.account.sign_out_failed: Sign-out did not complete. Try again.
authority.app.tagline: The authority's picture of the airspace: it observes, it never commands an aircraft
authority.app.title: {name} inspector console
authority.degraded.alerts_replaying: The active violations are being read back: the list is filling in.
authority.degraded.alerts_unconfirmed: An active violation was not republished: it may have ended. It is kept, not dropped.
authority.degraded.cis_absent: No restrictions from the CIS: restrictions may be missing.
authority.degraded.cis_absent_age: No current restrictions from the CIS ({age} old): restrictions may be missing.
authority.degraded.cis_stale: The CIS restrictions are stale: restrictions may be old.
authority.degraded.cis_stale_age: The CIS restrictions are stale, {age} old: restrictions may be old.
authority.degraded.dp_unavailable: The Display Provider is unavailable: tracks reported by USSPs are missing.
authority.degraded.manned_unavailable: Manned traffic from the ANSP is not live: manned aircraft are missing or old; the sky is not empty.
authority.degraded.nats_unavailable: The bus is unavailable: the picture is frozen, nothing is removed and every aircraft ages. Violations are not confirmed.
authority.degraded.nats_unavailable_sinc: The bus is unavailable since {since}: the picture is frozen, nothing is removed and every aircraft ages. Violations are not confirmed.
authority.degraded.no_subscription: This console has not subscribed to a viewport yet: an empty picture is not an empty sky.
authority.degraded.policy_default: No authority policy was read: the documented defaults are in force and thresholds may differ from the authority's.
authority.degraded.projections_unreadabl: The projections cannot be read: their ages are estimates.
The projections cannot be read: the registry projection was {age} old when last read.
authority.degraded.registry_projection_a: The registry was never projected: identifications say the registry is unavailable.
The registry projection is absent ({age} old): identifications say the registry is unavailable.
authority.degraded.session_unchecked: The session could not be checked: the connection will close if it cannot be checked soon.
authority.degraded.session_verifier_unav: Sessions cannot be verified: new consoles are refused.
authority.degraded.source_control_unknow: The source switches were never read: every source counts as enabled, and who disabled one may be missing.
authority.degraded.title: The picture is degraded
authority.degraded.tracks_evicted: The server's track cache is full: aircraft may be missing.
authority.degraded.viewport_too_large: The viewport is too large: the previous viewport is still shown. Zoom in.
authority.feed.label: Picture feed
authority.feed.no_thresholds: not received yet: no age is bucketed until the server sends them
authority.feed.not_shown_value: {tracks} track frames and {violations} violation frames refused, {other} frames of a kind this map does not draw, {evicted} tracks evicted at the console's bound, {malformed} malformed frames
authority.feed.thresholds_value: stale after {stale}, live within {live}, policy {policy} (as the server sends them)
authority.footer.observer: Observation only: this console sends nothing to any aircraft.
authority.locale.label: Language
authority.login.intro: Your password, then the one-time code from your authenticator app.
authority.login.problem.bff_unavailable: The console is not configured to sign in. Tell the administrator.
authority.login.problem.invalid_credenti: The username or the password is wrong.
authority.login.problem.mfa_challenge_mi: The sign-in step has expired. Start again with your password.
authority.login.problem.origin_refused: Sign-in refused: the page was not opened from this console's address.
authority.login.problem.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait and try again.
authority.login.problem.upstream_invalid: The sign-in service answered in a way the console does not understand. Tell the administrator.
authority.login.title: Sign in to the inspector console
authority.map.not_configured: The map has no first view configured: {problem}.
authority.nav.label: Pages
authority.notice.manned_not_drawn: Manned traffic is not drawn on this map yet; its absence here says nothing about manned aircraft.
authority.side.label: Picture details
authority.track.title: Selected aircraft
authority.tracks.empty: No aircraft in this console's picture. Check the feed state, the degraded states and the sources before reading this as an empty sky.
authority.tracks.server_age: {age} since captured, as the server measured
authority.tracks.title: Aircraft
authority.tracks.unverified_provider: as reported by a provider and unverified
authority.violation.clear.authorised: an authorisation caps the height (U-space airspace)
authority.violation.clear.reconfigured: the zones or the policy changed
authority.violation.clear.stale: the aircraft is no longer heard
authority.violations.empty: No active violation in this console's picture.
authority.violations.title: Active violations
authority.zones.failed: The zones could not be read: the map shows no zones, which does not mean there are none.
authority.zones.refused: The zones are not available to this session (status {status}): the map shows no zones, which does not mean there are none.
authority.zones.truncated: Not every zone was read: the list is longer than the console reads at once.
authority.zones.undrawn: Published but not drawn (a circle or another shape the map cannot draw as published): {ids}.
